metadata.title: Great-Expectations AI Governance Component Definition
metadata.remarks: Component definition derived from Great-Expectations Governance Benchmark

components.title: Great-Expectations
components.description: AI/ML component for Great-Expectations with governance controls

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure every governed dataset has versioned Expectations linked to its intended use

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Define and version Expectations for each governed dataset so data-quality rules are explicit, reviewable, and tied to the dataset's intended downstream AI or analytics use.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Coverage = governed datasets with approved Expectation Suites / total governed datasets in scope.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure Expectation coverage reaches 100% before a governed dataset is approved for downstream use.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: GX Core is built around Expectations as unit tests for data, making Expectation coverage the primary governance control.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure schema Expectations validate required columns, types, and nullability

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Use Expectations to validate required columns, data types, column presence, and nullability so schema drift is detected before downstream use.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Schema conformance rate, missing-column rate, type-mismatch rate

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Schema conformance = records or batches satisfying schema Expectations / total validated records or batches; mismatch rates computed from failed validations.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure schema conformance remains above threshold and schema mismatch rates remain below threshold for governed datasets.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Great Expectations directly supports schema-style validations via Expectations, so this is a core platform-native rule.

props.name: Sub_Risk
props.value: Unexpected nulls or missing critical values

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure critical fields satisfy completeness Expectations

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Apply Expectations to critical columns so null rates, missing values, or incomplete records are detected before the data is consumed by training or inference pipelines.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Completeness rate = rows satisfying non-null or completeness Expectations / total validated rows; null-value rate = failing rows / total validated rows.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure completeness for critical fields remains above threshold and null-value rates remain below threshold.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: GX is widely used to test completeness rules before data enters downstream systems.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure critical columns satisfy approved range and distribution Expectations

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Validate governed columns against allowed ranges, sets, quantiles, or distribution thresholds so out-of-bound or anomalous data is flagged before use.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Violation rate = rows or batches failing range or distribution Expectations / total validated rows or batches.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure range-violation and distribution-drift rates remain below approved thresholds for governed datasets.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Great Expectations supports expressive value and distribution checks, which are central to dataset quality assurance.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure uniqueness Expectations are applied to keys and deduplication-sensitive fields

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Validate unique keys and deduplication-sensitive columns so duplicate rows do not distort downstream analytics, training, or evaluation datasets.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Duplicate-record rate = duplicate rows or key collisions / total validated rows; uniqueness pass rate = rows satisfying uniqueness Expectations / total validated rows.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure duplicate-record rates remain below threshold and uniqueness pass rates remain above threshold for governed keys.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: GX has direct Expectation patterns for uniqueness and key integrity, making this a native control.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure representation Expectations are defined for critical populations, classes, or segments

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Define and validate expectations around subgroup composition so governed datasets do not materially underrepresent required populations or categories.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Coverage ratio, subgroup representation ratio, class imbalance ratio

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Compute subgroup proportions and compare them to approved representativeness thresholds or expected production distributions.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure subgroup coverage remains within approved representativeness thresholds before the dataset is approved for downstream AI use.

props.name: Threshold_Value
props.value: No subgroup below 80% of expected coverage

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: GX can validate expected proportions and distributions, which is useful for fairness-related dataset gating.

props.name: Sub_Risk
props.value: PII or confidential data in unapproved fields

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure sensitive-data Expectations are applied to governed columns and tables

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Validate that governed datasets do not contain unauthorized personal or confidential values in columns, fields, or free-text locations where they are not allowed.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: PII leakage rate, confidential-data exposure rate, precision, recall

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Leakage rate = sensitive values detected in unauthorized locations / total governed validation samples; compute precision and recall where classifiers or detectors are used.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure PII and confidential-data exposure remain below threshold and privacy-detection recall remains above threshold before production approval.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: GX does not natively classify all PII, but it is a practical validation framework for enforcing approved sensitive-data rules in data pipelines.

props.name: Sub_Risk
props.value: Validation not executed before downstream use

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure checkpoints run before governed data is promoted downstream

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Use Checkpoints to require successful validation results before governed datasets are promoted to downstream training, analytics, or serving pipelines.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Checkpoint enforcement coverage, failed-gate bypass rate

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Coverage = governed pipelines with enforced Checkpoints / total governed pipelines; bypass rate = downstream promotions despite failed validation / total governed failed validations.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure Checkpoint enforcement coverage reaches 100% and failed-gate bypass remains at zero for governed pipelines.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: GX Checkpoints are the primary mechanism to operationalize validation gates before downstream use.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure failed validation results trigger review or remediation workflows

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Require that failed Expectation or Checkpoint results are reviewed, triaged, and either remediated or explicitly approved before reuse of the governed data asset.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Validation-review completion rate, unresolved critical failure count

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Completion rate = failed validation results with completed review or remediation / total failed validation results; unresolved critical failure count from governed exceptions.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure failed-validation review completion reaches 100% and unresolved critical failures remain at zero before downstream reuse.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Validation results are only useful if failures trigger review; GX makes those results explicit and documentable.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure validation results are retained and linked to the exact data asset and Expectation Suite used

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Retain validation results with clear linkage to the dataset, batch, data source, and Expectation Suite version so audits and incident reviews can reconstruct data-quality status.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Completeness = retained validation results with linked dataset, batch, source, and Expectation Suite version / total governed validation results.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure validation-result traceability completeness reaches 100% for all governed validation runs.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: GX automatically produces validation artifacts that can serve as evidence, making traceability a core governance strength.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure Data Docs are generated for governed validation outcomes

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Generate and retain Data Docs or equivalent documentation for governed Expectation Suites and validation results so quality evidence is understandable to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Coverage = governed validation suites or checkpoints with generated and accessible Data Docs / total governed validation suites or checkpoints.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure Data Docs coverage reaches 100% for governed validation assets.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: The repo explicitly states GX can automatically generate documentation for each set of validation results, making this a direct repo-grounded control.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure row-count Expectations detect unexpected volume shifts

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Validate row-count ranges and dataset-size thresholds so unexpected spikes or drops are detected before the dataset is consumed downstream.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Deviation rate = validation runs where row-count expectations fail / total validation runs; anomaly rate computed from approved volume thresholds.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure row-count deviation and volume-anomaly rates remain below approved thresholds for governed datasets.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Volume shifts are a common early signal of ingestion or upstream system issues, and GX is well suited to catching them.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure relational integrity Expectations validate key relationships across governed data assets

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Validate that foreign-key-like relationships, join keys, or approved table-level integrity assumptions remain correct across governed data assets.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Pass rate = validated relationships satisfying approved integrity expectations / total tested relationships; broken-key rate = failing relationships / total tested relationships.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure relational-integrity pass rates remain above threshold and broken-key rates remain below threshold for governed data assets.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: GX can validate multi-source or table-level relationships through expectation logic, which is important for trustworthy downstream joins and features.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure governed validation workloads meet approved runtime overhead limits

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Benchmark validation execution time and resource usage so Expectation Suites remain practical to run at the required pipeline frequency.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Validation runtime, validation CPU or memory overhead

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Measure validation execution time and resource use on representative datasets and compare against the approved operational budget.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure governed validation runtime and resource overhead remain within the approved operational budget.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: GX must be operationally sustainable in pipelines; excessive validation overhead can drive teams to skip checks.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure Expectation Suite changes are versioned and reviewed before adoption

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Version and review material changes to Expectation Suites so governance-critical rules are not weakened, removed, or changed without approval.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Coverage = material Expectation Suite changes with completed review and approval / total material Expectation Suite changes in scope.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure approved-expectation-change coverage reaches 100% for all governed Expectation changes.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Since Expectations encode data policy, changes to them are effectively governance changes and should be controlled accordingly.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure validations run only against approved data assets and data sources

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Restrict GX Data Contexts, datasources, and validation configurations to governed assets so unauthorized or shadow data sources are not included in production validation workflows.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Coverage = governed GX contexts and pipelines using only approved data assets and datasources / total governed GX contexts and pipelines.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure approved-datasource coverage reaches 100% before production approval.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: This is a governance-layer rule applied to how GX is configured and used in production data-quality workflows.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure governed GX projects cover schema, completeness, uniqueness, privacy, representativeness, and pipeline-gating tests

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Build a Great Expectations validation standard that requires representative testing across schema, completeness, duplicates, distributions, privacy, fairness-sensitive composition, and gating domains.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Coverage = number of mandated GX data-risk domains with active Expectation or Checkpoint evidence / total mandated domains in the validation standard.

props.name: HF_Metric
props.value: Composite evaluation coverage based on benchmark families

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure risk-test coverage remains at or above threshold across the required GX validation domains.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: GX is a validation framework, so release readiness should be framed as breadth and rigor of data-quality evidence.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure governed datasets have complete documentation of quality rules, intended use, and validation status

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Document dataset purpose, key quality expectations, sensitivity constraints, representativeness assumptions, and current validation status for each governed dataset.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Completeness = completed required transparency fields / total required transparency fields for each governed dataset.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure dataset transparency completeness reaches 100% before the dataset is approved for governed use.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: GX helps preserve institutional knowledge about data through documented Expectations and validation results, according to the repo README.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure GX Data Contexts, datasources, checkpoints, and documentation outputs are documented for governed systems

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Document the GX Data Context, datasources, Expectation Suites, Checkpoints, validation stores, and Data Docs outputs used in each governed environment.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Completeness = completed required architecture and validation workflow fields / total required fields in the approved transparency checklist.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure system transparency completeness reaches 100% before production approval.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: GX governance depends on understanding the full validation workflow, not just individual Expectations.
